publisher: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions

references.purpose: alternating-series continuation of zeta on Re(s)>0

derived_use.eta_half_positive: pair the alternating series as sum_k((2k-1)^(-1/2)-(2k)^(-1/2)); every summand is positive
derived_use.xi_zero_nonzero: the completed prefactor at s=1/2 is finite and nonzero, hence Xi(0)=xi(1/2) is nonzero

wording_rule: Use the exact equation identifiers and an independent elementary sign proof; do not treat a decimal approximation as nonvanishing evidence.
